national_news.title: India and New Zealand Sign MoC on Electronic Origin Data Exchange
bullets: India and New Zealand signed a Memorandum of Cooperation (MoC) on Electronic Origin Data Exchange to facilitate trade under the India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA).
The agreement was signed by Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) Chairman Vivek Chaturvedi and Christine Stevenson, Comptroller and Chief Executive of New Zealand Customs Service.
The MoC aims to deepen customs cooperation, leverage digitalization, reduce information gaps, and ensure smooth trade preferences for eligible businesses.

national_news.title: India Wins 27 Medals on Day 3 of Asian Para Games in Japan
bullets: India clinched 27 medals (5 Gold, 11 Silver, 11 Bronze) on Day 3 of the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, taking its overall medal tally to 62 (5th position).
Dilip Gavit won Gold in the men's 100m T46/47 event, while Sachin Sarjerao Khilari set a Games record throw of 15.87m to win Gold in the men's Shot Put F46.
Sprinter Simran secured her second gold medal of the Games by winning the women's 100m T12 event with a new Games record time of 12.02 seconds.

national_news.title: Government Sets Target to Eliminate Drug Menace by December 2029
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced a national deadline of December 31, 2029, to completely eliminate the drug menace from India.
Speaking at the Police Commemoration Day ceremony at the National Police Memorial in New Delhi, he flagged off a nationwide motorcycle rally under the theme 'Fight Against Drugs'.
The Home Minister paid homage to the 36,852 police personnel who have laid down their lives in the line of duty since Independence.

national_news.title: Nation Observes 70th Dhammachakra Pravartan Day at Deekshabhoomi
bullets: Millions of followers paid homage to Bharat Ratna Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar at Deekshabhoomi in Nagpur on the 70th Dhammachakra Pravartan Day.
The annual observance commemorates Dr. Ambedkar embracing Buddhism along with millions of followers on October 14, 1956, on Vijayadashami.
Venerable Wannasiri Mahathero from Myanmar addressed the main ceremony, emphasizing the message of equality, liberty, fraternity, and human dignity.
